package.name: mowgli_leds
package.description:
WS2812 (NeoPixel) status ring for the Mowgli robot mower. Renders the high-level robot state, mowing progress, charge level and RTK health onto an addressable LED ring driven from the SBC over SPI MOSI.
Read-only with respect to the robot: it subscribes to status topics and writes to /dev/spidev. It shares nothing with the motion, dig-detection, coverage or localization stacks, and it is NOT part of the blade-safety path (the STM32 firmware remains the sole blade safety authority and owns its own status LED).
